timeline.text: Company founded. First 1,000 clients and a CySEC license.
ECN execution launched with direct agreements with Tier-1 liquidity providers.
Offices opened in Dubai and Almaty. 100,000 active traders.
Proprietary trading infrastructure: servers in LD4, NY4 and TY3, execution from 14 ms.
One million active clients. Crypto trading and swap-free accounts launched.
A new ecosystem: web platform, mobile PWA app and a unified client area.

promos.description: Fund your first account with $500 or more — get +30% in trading funds. The bonus counts towards margin and helps you withstand drawdowns.
